title: VOiLA: Vectorized Online Planning with Learned Diffusion Models for POMDP Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.19729v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Planning under uncertainty is an essential capability for autonomous robots. The Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) provides a powerful framework for such a capability. Although POMDP-based planning has advanced significantly, its application to real-world problems is often limited by the difficulty of obtaining faithful POMDP models. We present Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents (VOiLA), a framework that learns task-agnostic POMDP world models for online planning under uncertainty. Specifically, VOiLA learns transition and observation samplers using conditional diffusion models and observation-likelihood models for particle-based belief updates. translated_title: VOiLA：面向POMDP智能体的基于学习扩散模型的向量化在线规划
translated_abstract: 在不确定性下进行规划是自主机器人的一项关键能力。部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）为这种能力提供了强大的框架。尽管基于POMDP的规划已取得显著进展，但其在现实问题中的应用往往受限于难以获得忠实的POMDP模型。我们提出了VOiLA（Vectorized Online planning wIth Learned diffusion model for POMDP Agents，面向POMDP智能体的基于学习扩散模型的向量化在线规划），这是一个学习任务无关的POMDP世界模型、用于在不确定性下进行在线规划的框架。具体而言，VOiLA使用条件扩散模型学习状态转移和观测采样器，并学习观测似然模型以进行基于粒子的信念更新。为实现高效的在线规划，扩散采样器被蒸馏为紧凑的前馈生成器，并与VOPP（向量化在线POMDP规划器）集成，VOPP是一种旨在利用GPU并行化能力的在线POMDP规划器。
tldr: VOiLA通过条件扩散模型学习任务无关的POMDP世界模型，并将其蒸馏为紧凑的前馈生成器，与利用GPU并行化的在线POMDP规划器VOPP相结合，实现了不确定性下的高效在线规划。
en_tdlr: VOiLA learns task-agnostic POMDP world models using conditional diffusion models, distills the samplers into compact feedforward generators, and integrates them with the GPU-vectorized online POMDP planner VOPP to enable efficient online planning under uncertainty.
